text.description_html:
PDQ MR-PFEF Grade 1 Commercial Mortise Lock Sets with Escutcheon

The PDQ MR-PFEF series extra heavy duty mortise locksets conform to Federal Specification FF-H-106 Type 86. The latchbolt can be fully retracted with 35 degree lever rotation. They have a limited lifetime manufacturer's warranty. The Commercial Grade 1 Mortise Lockset comes with a Escutcheon Plate.

Complies with ANSI A156.13-2002, Series 1000, Grade 1. Listed by UL / ULC for ratings of “A” label (3 hours) and less, UL10C / UBC 7-2 (1997) positive pressure, for single doors up to 4’0” x 8’0”.

Windstorm Resistant Product Listed - ANSI A250.13-2003, ASTM E1886-02, ASTM E330-02, Outswing: 350 ft-lbs., Inswing: N/R, Design Load Rating: 2453 lbf. (Functions with deadbolts only).

Assembled in the USA meeting the requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant levers are solid cast, with no plastic inserts.

Specifications for the PDQ MR Series Mortise Leversets:

  • Mortise Case: 5-7/8" x 4-1/8" x 7/8". 13-gauge heavy duty wrought steel. Zinc and clear chromate for corrosion resistance. One case size for all functions.
  • Armored Front: 8" x 1-1/4". Brass or stainless steel. ANSI Standard A115.1. Adjustable from flat to beveled 1/8" in 2" bevel.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" thick. Contact us for thicker doors.
  • Deadbolt (for deadbolt functions): 9/16" x 1-1/4". 1" throw. Stainless steel.
  • Guardbolt: Stainless steel. Non-handed.
  • Latchbolt: 3/4" Throw / Investment Cast Stainless Steel /Anti-friction Standard
  • Stop Works: Stainless steel. Rocker type.
  • Door Prep: Fits standard mortise 86 door prep.
  • Backsets: 2-3/4"
  • Hand Case: Handed. Reversible in field.
  • Front: 2-1/4" X 1-1/8" Beveled 1/8" on 2".
  • Strike: 4-7/8" x 1-1/4" x 3/32" (ASA). Stainless steel or brass.
  • Overall Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Lever Length: 5-1/2"
  • Escutcheon Width: 2-1/16"
  • Escutcheon Height: 7-5/8"
  • Trim: Philadelphia levers solid zinc diecast.
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Keyways: Schlage "C" Standard.
  • Cylinder: Brass 6-pin cylinder keyed to 5 pins; 1-1/8" long standard mortise lock cylinder.
  • Certifications: ANSI A156.13, Series 1000, Grade 1. Meets all accessibility requirements of the ADA. Conforms to Federal Specifications FF-H-106 Type 86.
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime manufacturer warranty
  • PDQ MR Series Mortise Lock Installation Template (PDF)
  • PDQ MR-PFEF Specifications (PDF)
